== Description ==
'''UI-30''' is the 3rd entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
Like many other I-Section entities, it will play the "Horror Race" theme song upon being spawned. '''UI-30''' will spawn behind the player and rush to the current room at a moderately fast pace. It will play UI-20's sound but with a lower pitch. Once '''UI-30''' reaches the current room, it will then rebound back to its spawning room. Once '''UI-30''' reaches the room he spawned in when he rebounded, he will then disappear.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* As soon as you see or hear '''UI-30''', hide as it will approach you quickly, faster than UI-20.
** '''UI-30''' can catch you off guard when exiting a hiding spot, as it is decently fast, which can get you killed if you aren't paying too close attention.

* If you're unsure whether '''UI-30''' has spawned or not, wait for the entity to pass by or wait for its ambient theme to stop.

* '''UI-30''' will rebound once. Once it passes, it will not appear again.
** In rare cases, '''UI-30''' may appear twice, giving the impression that it rebounded again. Be careful of this when you're further in the I-Section.

== Trivia ==
* Like all the other I-Section entities, '''UI-30''' was added as an April Fools joke.
* '''UI-30''' can look like A-60 due to the similarities of A-60's faces with '''UI-30'''.
